name: peru-cross-border-tax
description: Work through Peru cross-border income-tax questions for tax year 2026 before applying a withholding rate or treating foreign income as exempt. Covers individual domicile and arrival or departure timing, Peru-source income, foreign enterprises and permanent establishments, ordinary non-resident royalties, dividends, technical assistance and external-credit screening, treaty eligibility, residence certificates, foreign-tax credits and the controlled-foreign-entity screen. Use for Peru non-resident withholding, no domiciliado, renta de fuente extranjera, moving to or leaving Peru, foreign clients, UK-Peru treaty commencement and Declara Facil 617. Produces a residence timeline, source classification, withholding working and filing checklist for an accountant or finance team. The domestic annual individual or corporate return remains in its own skill; complete treaty-rate tables, securities reorganisations and specialist CFC computations are not supplied.
